name: Pizzeria Zirm
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizzeria Zirm in Jerzens**

Welcome to **Pizzeria Zirm** in the heart of **Jerzens**, where authentic Italian flavors meet the charm of the **Tirol** Alps. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this cozy spot offers freshly baked **Pizza**, crispy **Calzones**, and delicious **Pasta**—all made with the finest ingredients.

Indulge in our signature dishes like the **Tiroler Klassiker** (a hearty pizza with local **Speck**, **Käse**, and fresh herbs) or enjoy a classic **Margherita** with a twist. For dessert, treat yourself to a warm slice of **Tiramisu** or a scoop of homemade **Eis**—perfect for sharing after a day of exploring the stunning **Zillertal** valley.

Whether you're craving a quick bite or a full meal, **Pizzeria Zirm** delivers warmth, taste, and a touch of **Tirol** hospitality. Come by for a taste of Italy in the mountains!
